function.name: concert_search_find_concerts
function.description: Locate concerts at a specific venue on a specific date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

venue.description: The name of the concert venue.

date.description: The date of the concert in YYYY-MM-DD format.

artist.description: The name of the artist or band, if looking for a specific performer. This parameter is optional. Default: 'chris nolan'
